Crime Ki Kahani: bihar ke motihari se ek aisi ghatna samne aaee hai, jisne pure ilake ko hairan kar diya hai. divali ki rat ghar men ek 15 varshiy larki ki sandigdh paristhitiyon men maut ho gaee. lekin is ghatna ke bad jo huaa, usne mamle ko aur bhi rahasyamay bana diya. janie is vidiyo men motihari kraim ki puri kahani
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
